log_level.description: Logging level: minimal, default, or maximal. Corresponds to --log-level.

enabled_logs.description: List of log types to enable in addition to log level. Corresponds to --enable.

disabled_logs.description: List of log types to disable. Corresponds to --disable.

hwinfo_path.description: Path to the hwinfo binary. Corresponds to --hwinfo-path.

inventory_id.description: Inventory ID for the probe. Corresponds to -i.

email.description: Email address for notifications. Corresponds to --email.

id.description: Description or name of the probe. Corresponds to --id.

pci_ids_path.description: Path to PCI IDs file. Corresponds to --pci-ids.

usb_ids_path.description: Path to USB IDs file. Corresponds to --usb-ids.

sdio_ids_path.description: Path to SDIO IDs file. Corresponds to --sdio-ids.

pnp_ids_path.description: Path to PNP IDs file. Corresponds to --pnp-ids.

upload.description: Upload result to hardware database. Corresponds to --upload.

monitor_start.description: Start monitoring of the node. Corresponds to --start.

monitor_stop.description: Stop monitoring of the node. Corresponds to --stop.

save_dir.description: Directory to save probe package. Corresponds to --save.

src_path.description: Path to existing probe to upload. Corresponds to --src.

fix_path.description: Path to update device info in probe. Corresponds to --fix.

import_dir.description: Directory to import probes. Corresponds to --import.
